simple.meaning: שָׁקַד (shâqad) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to be (intensively, make ) almond-shaped.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 6 times in Exodus, beginning at Exodus 25:33. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שָׁקַד (H8246) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: שָׁקַד (shâqad) / H8246 is traced through Exodus 25:33, Exodus 25:34, Exodus 37:19, Exodus 37:20 with source-language evidence and verse context.
